title: Profit giveback lockout
statement: After building session profit, giving back half of the session high-water profit is a walk-away trigger.

evidence.title: How I Made $500,000 in 7 Days of Day Trading (Full Training)
evidence.note: The full training gives the 50% profit-giveback walk-away rule.

title: Daily max-loss calibration
statement: The general teaching calibrates max daily loss around the trader's recent/typical average daily gain rather than an arbitrary fixed dollar number.

evidence.title: How I Made $500,000 in 7 Days of Day Trading (Full Training)
evidence.note: The full training states max loss is whatever the average daily gain is.

title: Session exit is terminal
statement: After deciding to walk away for the day, stop watching/trading and do not return later because re-entry is associated with FOMO and poor decisions.

evidence.title: How I Made $500,000 in 7 Days of Day Trading (Full Training)
evidence.note: The training explicitly says not to come back after leaving.

title: Catalyst substance over keyword stuffing
statement: Headline quality depends on substantive economic/news content and context, not merely fashionable keywords; keyword-stuffed releases can look stronger than they are.

evidence.title: Trading Breaking News
evidence.note: The breaking-news lesson explicitly warns about keyword stuffing and distinguishes headline appearance from underlying substance.

title: Raw transcripts are offline research only
statement: Historical replay and paper/live decision code must never retrieve raw retrospective transcripts; only versioned distilled strategy knowledge may enter the decision path.

title: Unknown publication dates are quarantined
statement: Any transcript without a resolved publication date is excluded from chronology-sensitive training and walk-forward experiments until its date is established.
